project.name: Portal LEVA
project.description: Internal corporate knowledge management platform for an automotive dealership group (Renault, Geely, Bajaj). B2B internal tool. Professional, trustworthy, slightly premium.

theme_and_archetype.description: Authority, clarity, and function-first. Optimized for deep reading and knowledge retention with a slightly premium corporate automotive feel. Crisp whites, deep off-blacks, clean technical typography.

typography.guidelines: Do not use generic sans for headings. Emphasize tracking and line-height for readability. Body font should be geometric and legible.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-8 or p-12 for main containers to ensure breathing room. Containers with border must have internal padding.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed left lateral navigation. w-64 or w-72. Clean, minimal, Notion-like item list. No default background colors for inactive items.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B (Control Room Grid) - Dense, structured. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized.
layout_and_spacing.article_view: max-w-4xl mx-auto for optimal reading width. Generous top padding (pt-12 or pt-16).

components.surface_strategy: Grid Borders & Flat Design. Cards have flat backgrounds with 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), no default shadow. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
components.header_nav: Sticky topbar with Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-slate-200/50) for the search bar, breadcrumbs, and profile.
components.search: Cmd+K Quick Search Dialog. Takes center stage when active, blurring the background. Use Shadcn Command component.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid slate-900, text-white, hover:bg-slate-800. Secondary: Outline, border-slate-200, hover:bg-slate-50. Radius: max 8px (rounded-md).

media_urls.description: Abstract premium automotive lines, sleek metallic finish. Used for the split-screen login page background. Place behind an overlay of bg-slate-900/30.

accessibility_and_interactions.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA standards. Text on images must have sufficient contrast or overlay.
accessibility_and_interactions.animations: Micro-interactions on hover. Smooth page transitions. No jarring bouncing.
accessibility_and_interactions.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-link').

iconography.style: Stroke width 1.5, consistent size (w-5 h-5 for sidebar, w-4 h-4 for inline labels).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn components heavily for forms, dialogs, command palette (Cmd+K), and dropdowns. Customize them to remove the default Vercel look by applying the color palette and border radii specified here.
The UI should feel like a premium corporate version of Notion: lots of whitespace, strong typography, minimal borders, very calm design.
Implement the Notion-style block editor layout for the article view (Title, Tags, Categories, Breadcrumbs).
Make the lateral navigation sidebar collapsible with a smooth transition. Include nested tree views for categories.
Build the dashboard with the 'Control Room Grid' mode - using exact height matches and utilizing all pixels efficiently. Include sections for recent content and most accessed articles.
Ensure the application language and dummy text are in Portuguese (Brazilian).
Implement fluid experience (smooth scrolling, minimal page reloads, quick search).
